name: flutter-html-reproduce
description: Reproduces a Flutter UI page from an HTML input (file / URL / screenshot / snippet) via a 5-phase pipeline: Source & Align -> Skeleton -> Styles -> Assets+States -> Verify. Bundles the orchestrator skill plus six sub-skills (source-fetcher, align-table, dom-to-widget-tree, css-to-style, asset-export, pixel-diff).
